articles.summary: Navigating the world of elder care can be overwhelming, especially when trying to determine the best type of care for a senior citizen. This guide breaks down the five main types of care: at-home caregivers, senior living facilities, assisted living, nursing homes, and memory care units. Learn about the services each type provides, along with their associated costs, to make an informed decision for yourself or a loved one.
articles.title: What is Care and When do you need it as a Senior Citizen?
